//go:build goexperiment.simd && amd64

package zopfli

import (
	"runtime"
	"simd/archsimd"
	"testing"
)

func TestMeasurementCPU(t *testing.T) {
	t.Logf("runtime=%s CPUs=%d AVX=%v AVX2=%v AVX512=%v", runtime.Version(), runtime.NumCPU(), archsimd.X86.AVX(), archsimd.X86.AVX2(), archsimd.X86.AVX512())
}
